lines: WOOF WOOF!! WOOF WOOF WOOF WOOF!!
It's the Taimanin!! Don't let them escape!!
Ahhhhh~ There's no end to them!! I can't fight wearing something like this!!
Sana was furious and ripped off the Armed Refugee clothing she was wearing as a disguise.
Eeeeh!? Sana-senpai, is it okay to take those off!?
It doesn't matter, Shikanosuke!! They'll find us because of our scents even if we're wearing it!!
I shouted over to Shikanosuke and also ripped off the Armed Refugee clothes.
I-I see... then I'll take them off too!
Hebiko too!! It's hard to move in these anyway!
Shikanosuke and Hebiko also ripped off the clothing and started to fight.
UFS troops and Armed Refugees had gathered around us, and it was truly becoming a massive melee.
And... our plan got ruined again! We'll never get to Yomihara like this!
I spoke rapid-fire to Sana, who was grumbling while fighting off the attack.
About that... Sana-san, have you ever heard about the "secret passage"?
Yes, I remembered a book that I read before... Hebiko, smokescreen on the right side!! And Shikanosuke! Watch out for stray bullets!!

Shikanosuke: Aieeeee!!? I-I knooow!!
Hebiko: Alright, Fuma-chan!!
While calling out to Sana-san, I gave orders to Shikanosuke and Hebiko. It was so hectic that it felt like I was about to go crazy.
So, what about that secret passage!?
Ah, right!! The secret passageーis the remains of a hidden mine shaft!!
According to a book I had readー
When workers were excavating to build this flood bypass, they apparently ran into the remains of a hidden mine from the Sengoku era.
The remains of that mine were said to sprawl deep underground in this vicinity, like an ant's nest.
Can't we use that as a passage to get to Yomihara!?
She seemed to have known about the tunnels, but for some reason didn't seem inclined to use them.
I mean, like you said, it's possible to descend to Yomihara through those tunnels.
Get behind them!! Don't let them get away!!
Kill the Taimanin!! The reward is right in front of us!!
WOOF!!! WOOF WOOF WOOF WOOF WOOF!!
Aieeee!!! We're gonna die, we're gonna die!! Fuma, what should we doooooo!!!?
Ahhhh!? Sana-san, we don't have time to hesitate!!
Uuugh... a-alright!! Let's use those tunnels!!
But just so you know... that place is also dangerous!! Don't ever let your guard down!!
With a new route to aim for, the "secret passage," we retreated as fast as we could.
